question: How much no-change pass/fail churn and subset-estimation error is observable in the published fixed-setup label matrix?
scope: Offline outcome replay only; no agent runs, no edits, no inference, no repository scripts.
held_out_runs: 3 through N inclusive in each group; file-order indices, NOT timestamps
selection: hash_uniform: choose the k task IDs with smallest SHA256(salt + ':' + task ID)
history_stratified: partition tasks by the ordered two-label training pattern, allocate k proportionally using floor + largest remainder (tie by pattern), choose smallest hashes within each stratum
estimators: for history_stratified also population-stratum weighted pass rate
metrics: per-group all-pairs and adjacent-pair label churn
false no-change alarm rate for absolute estimated delta > 0.05 vs training-run mean
comparisons: Descriptive single frozen draw only; no winner, statistical superiority, causal regression-detection, or actual token savings claim.
leakage_caveat: Cohort membership and file availability come from the complete published archive. No held-out labels influence subset or weights. Group file order is arbitrary.
resource_constraint: Download only small manifests/maps and optional small cost summaries; no traces, embeddings, weights, new installs, or downloaded-code execution.
